name: Eventbrite API
tagline: Self-serve event creation and discovery API for listings and ticketed events
description: Eventbrite's Platform API lets developers create, manage, and discover events and ticketed experiences. It covers event listings, venues, orders, attendees, and organization data for building integrations around event discovery and management.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 private token or app OAuth; Authorization: Bearer token header

use_cases: retrieve attendee lists for an event
create or update an event listing
